recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-14160 follow-up is needed; any review of FHIR-53692 status or diagram regeneration should be handled under those later changes rather than by restoring STU3-era source.
issue_request: FHIR-14160 asked BR&R to add the value set for the newly added ResearchStudy.primaryPurposeType element; Jira status is Published with a Persuasive resolution saying the change was made and published in the December 2017 FHIR ballot.
initial_application: No commit literally named FHIR-14160, but the November 2017 ResearchStudy application commit 271b5865933a3afcb3e636c823af2daf78efb9d9 added ResearchStudy.primaryPurposeType and populated the ResearchStudyPrimaryPurposeType value set worksheet; FHIR-14287 then narrowed that value set before the same ballot publication.
additional_context: ResearchStudy remains active in source/fhir.ini. Later changes moved the primary-purpose terminology to THO (FHIR-50710, already reconciled on the combined branch) and changed the current element to ResearchStudy.purposeType 0..* with an example binding (FHIR-53692). FHIR-37876 is additional binding-strength background. The checked-in SVG still has stale primaryPurposeType text, but the authoritative StructureDefinition XML is correct and SVG-only generated artifacts are not edited for this seed.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current build-scoped StructureDefinition already binds ResearchStudy.purposeType to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/research-study-prim-purp-type, and the old local core primary-purpose ValueSet files are intentionally absent after the THO migration.

related_jiras.note: Removed bio-banking and epidemiological from the initial ResearchStudyPrimaryPurposeType value set and is already represented on the combined branch.
Changed the same element family binding strength from extensible to preferred in R5.
Moved ResearchStudy primary-purpose terminology to THO and removed retired core terminology files; already represented on the combined branch.
Changed current ResearchStudy.primaryPurposeType 0..1 to ResearchStudy.purposeType 0..* with an example binding.
